name: gearbox
description: gearbox: model and effort for each subagent, decided by a local Laya model

plugins.name: gearbox
plugins.description: Picks model and effort for each subagent with Laya, a local decision model, and shows every subagent in a pane with its model, effort, tokens and files. Observes by default (logs its pick and how the agent ended, /gearbox report sums it up); in apply mode it starts subagents on the model it picks
